games.title: Need for Speed: Most Wanted — Web Port
games.desc: An experimental browser port of EA Black Box's 2005 PC street racer: chase the Blacklist through Rockport and outrun the police, rendered with WebAssembly and WebGPU.
games.controls: Keyboard or controller; remap in Options → Controls • Enter / Esc navigate menus • Press a controller button after connecting it.
games.goodToKnow: Requires a current desktop Chrome or Edge with WebGPU and hardware acceleration. Game data streams on demand and is cached in this browser. The port is experimental: online/LAN is unsupported, and full-career driving plus race-end autosaves still need testing.

games.title: Super Mario 64 (PC Port WebGL)
games.desc: The groundbreaking 1996 Nintendo 64 3D platformer running natively in your browser via the sm64pc decompilation: explore Peach’s Castle, collect Power Stars, and defeat Bowser with smooth 60 FPS WebGL rendering.
games.controls: WASD to move • L to jump (A) • Comma (,) to attack (B) • K to crouch (Z) • Shift for camera (R) • Space for Start • Arrow keys for C-buttons • Gamepad supported
games.goodToKnow: Based on the sm64pc native decompilation compiled to WebAssembly. Features full gamepad support, browser save file backups, and buttery smooth 60 FPS performance without any plugin installs.

games.title: Townscaper (Web Edition)
games.desc: Oskar Stålberg’s mesmerizing procedural town-building toy running natively in the browser: click to place bricks and arches and watch cobblestone villages, towering spires, and bridges emerge dynamically.
games.controls: Left click to place building block • Right click to remove • Drag to rotate camera • Mouse wheel to zoom
games.goodToKnow: Full procedural mesh generation and physics running in WebAssembly. You can save and export clipboard links of your creations.

games.title: Celeste Classic (PICO-8)
games.desc: The legendary PICO-8 precision platformer prototype that gave birth to Celeste: climb the mountain across 30 grueling single-screen stages with precision jumping and 8-directional air dashes.
games.controls: Arrow keys / WASD to move • C / Z to jump • X to dash
games.goodToKnow: Created in just 4 days during a game jam, Celeste Classic is one of the most celebrated and tight platformer prototypes ever made.

games.title: Legend of Legaia (Web Recompilation)
games.desc: Andrew Altimit's source-accurate static recompilation of the classic 1998 PS1 tactical turn-based RPG: battle through the Mist using the unique Tactical Arts combat system with high-res WebGL rendering.
games.controls: D-pad / Arrow keys to navigate • Z / Enter to confirm • X to cancel / menu • Gamepad supported
games.goodToKnow: Statically recompiled C++ to WebAssembly with high resolution rendering, full sound, and instant save state support in your browser local storage.

games.title: After Burner II (HTML5 Arcade Port)
games.desc: Sega’s iconic high-speed fighter jet arcade combat rewritten in pure HTML5 and melonJS: blast through supersonic dogfights, lock on with Tomahawk missiles, and dodge incoming bogeys at Mach 2.
games.controls: Arrow keys / WASD to steer jet • Space to fire vulcan cannon • X / Shift to launch missiles • C to throttle afterburner
games.goodToKnow: Full sprite scaling and authentic sound emulation running at 60 FPS directly in HTML5.

games.title: Web Dashers (Geometry Rhythm Platformer)
games.desc: High-octane one-button rhythm jumping platformer inspired by Geometry Dash: time your leaps over spikes and gravity portals synced to pulsating electronic soundtracks.
games.controls: Spacebar, Left Click, or Up Arrow to jump
games.goodToKnow: Includes official and custom level progression with full music synchronization and zero lag.

games.title: Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Web Engine
games.desc: A faithful browser recreation of Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team's tile-based turn-based rogue-lite dungeon crawler: choose your starter, explore shifting dungeons, and rescue Pokémon in distress.
games.controls: Arrow keys / WASD to move • Space / Enter to attack • M for menu • Shift to run
games.goodToKnow: Accurate turn logic, mystery dungeon grid movement, Pokémon moves, and original GBA chiptune audio.

games.title: Hege Mania (Browser Bullet Heaven)
games.desc: Fast-paced browser arena bullet heaven survivor: dodge surging waves of chaotic enemies, level up bizarre projectile synergies, and survive the swarm without installing a single byte.
games.controls: WASD / Arrow keys to move • Auto-aim and auto-shoot
games.goodToKnow: Runs smoothly even during intense late-game enemy density with hundreds of on-screen sprites.

games.title: APEX GP 26 (3D Formula Racer)
games.desc: High-speed 3D open-wheel formula racing in your browser powered by modern WebGPU rendering: nail the apex, battle responsive AI drivers, and set blistering lap times.
games.controls: WASD / Arrow keys to steer, accelerate, and brake • Space for handbrake • C to change camera
games.goodToKnow: Takes advantage of WebGPU when supported for advanced lighting, tyre smoke particles, and high framerates.

games.title: CrossCode (HTML5 Action-RPG)
games.desc: Radical Fish Games’ legendary 16-bit retro 2D Action-RPG running entirely on custom Canvas/HTML5 tech: explore CrossWorlds with Lea, solve puzzles, and master fast combat.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to aim • Left Click to melee/shoot ball • Right Click / Space to dash/guard • Tab to open menu
games.goodToKnow: A technical marvel of HTML5 canvas optimization with butter-smooth 60 FPS combat, rich story, and controller support.

games.title: Venge.io (Tactical 3D Hero Shooter)
games.desc: A slick objective-based 3D tactical hero shooter running on PlayCanvas: pick character cards, capture zones, and trigger special combat cards with zero installs.
games.controls: WASD to move • Left Click to shoot • Right Click to aim down sights • Space to jump • F to throw grenade • E to dance
games.goodToKnow: Capture the glowing green objective areas on the map to trigger card abilities like EMP grenades and extra health boosts.

games.title: Shell Shockers (3D Egg Battle FPS)
games.desc: The world’s hit egg-based online 3D shooter: arm your eggs with EggK-47s, Scramblers, and Crackshot sniper rifles across vibrant destructible arenas.
games.controls: WASD to move • Left Click to fire • Right Click or Shift to aim • Space to jump • R to reload • Q to throw grenade
games.goodToKnow: Supports Free For All, Teams, and Captula the Spatula modes. Customize your egg with stamps, hats, and weapon skins.

games.title: Smash Karts (3D Kart Battle Arena)
games.desc: An intense 3D multiplayer kart combat arena: pick up mystery boxes, fire homing rockets, drop landmines, and blast opponents in fast 3-minute battle rounds.
games.controls: WASD or Arrow keys to steer • Spacebar to fire weapons • Mouse to look around • Gamepad controller supported
games.goodToKnow: Level up your kart and unlock new drivers. Connect with friends in private rooms or jump into public matchmaking instantly.

games.title: Krunker.io (3D Multiplayer FPS)
games.desc: The iconic fast-paced browser FPS: custom soldier classes, smooth bhop slide movement, community map editor, and instant competitive multiplayer lobbies.
games.controls: WASD to move • Left Click to shoot • Right Click to aim down sights • Space to jump/bhop • Shift to crouch/slide • R to reload • 1-4 for weapon swap
games.goodToKnow: Runs natively in WebGL with zero downloads. Adjust Field of View and disable shadows in Settings if you need higher framerates on low-end hardware.

games.title: Need for Speed: Underground 2 (Web)
games.desc: Underground 2 Revived brings the 2004 PC street racer to a browser, with Bayview free roam, career progression, car tuning and a community-hosted online mode.
games.controls: Keyboard: arrows or WASD to drive • Space handbrake • Alt nitrous • USB/Bluetooth gamepad supported; bindings can be changed.
games.goodToKnow: Needs a recent desktop browser with WebGPU and hardware acceleration. Game data streams from the host and is cached; an optional preload is about 1.7 GB. The online service is community-run, not an EA service.

games.title: Burnout 3: Takedown (Web Preview)
games.desc: A browser preview of Criterion's 2004 crash-focused arcade racer, running the PS2 release with World Tour events and experimental private online rooms.
games.controls: Keyboard (rebindable) or USB/Bluetooth controller • Click the game view to capture input • On-page Controls panel shows the mapping.
games.goodToKnow: Requires an up-to-date desktop Chrome or Edge with WebGPU and hardware acceleration. The preview cannot save profiles reliably (answer No to the save prompt); the first race has an unskippable training section of about three minutes. Online is experimental and may desync.

games.title: Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition (Web)
games.desc: Play the PSP edition of Rockstar's 2005 open-world street racer in a browser, with city driving, car customisation, races and host-provided private rooms.
games.controls: Keyboard or gamepad • Click the game view to focus controls • Use the on-page Controls panel for the current key map.
games.goodToKnow: This is the PSP release, not the PS2 DUB Edition Remix. It loads automatically in a modern browser; saves stay in browser storage. The host offers experimental private Ad Hoc rooms, so use solo play if multiplayer is unavailable. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

games.title: Resident Evil Outbreak & File #2 (Web)
games.desc: Choose the original Resident Evil Outbreak or File #2, then play the PS2 survival-horror scenarios solo or in online co-op through a browser client.
games.controls: Keyboard and mouse or gamepad • Click the game view to focus input • Each File has its own control layout.
games.goodToKnow: The host loads game resources automatically; no local game files are requested. Unofficial and unaffiliated with Capcom; the project has not published source or authorization details, so availability may change. The host checks modern WebAssembly features (WebGPU is recommended; software fallback may be slow). Lobbies can lag, and memory-card saves remain in this browser—export a backup.

games.title: Fallout 1 & 2 (Rerun Reactor)
games.desc: Run either classic isometric RPG in a browser on the Fallout Community Edition engines, importing the game data from your own copy; the site also offers browser-local save tools.
games.controls: Mouse to point, select and interact • Keyboard shortcuts for inventory, map, dialogue and combat.
games.goodToKnow: Bring your own legally purchased Fallout 1 and/or Fallout 2 install folder, ZIP or disc image; no game content is included. Imported files and saves stay in this browser and are not uploaded. Export backups before clearing site data. Requires a modern browser with WebAssembly.

games.title: StarCraft: Brood War (OpenBW Web)
games.desc: The OpenBW engine runs the real Brood War simulation in a browser, with computer opponents, friend rooms and online matches.
games.controls: Mouse to select, move and command • Keyboard for classic RTS hotkeys • Choose a race, map and opponent before starting.
games.goodToKnow: No local install or account is required. First play fetches about 90 MB of original game data from Internet Archive and caches it. Free non-commercial fan project, unaffiliated with Blizzard.

games.title: Command & Conquer: Generals — Zero Hour (GeneralsX Web)
games.desc: GeneralsX brings the Zero Hour RTS runtime into a browser for skirmishes against the CPU, using a fan-made WebAssembly decompilation.
games.controls: Mouse to select and issue orders • Keyboard hotkeys for commands • Click the game canvas to capture input.
games.goodToKnow: Requires your own Command & Conquer: Generals and Zero Hour game files. Select the installed folder or a ZIP/ISO/BIN-CUE; files stay on your machine. A current desktop browser with WebGPU and hardware acceleration is recommended. Not an EA service.

games.title: Warcraft III (Warsmash Web)
games.desc: Warsmash's browser client can boot to Warcraft III's main menu for single-player/campaign or multiplayer, including peer-to-peer lobbies.
games.controls: Mouse to select and command • Standard Warcraft III hotkeys • Click the canvas to focus keyboard input.
games.goodToKnow: You must stage your own Warcraft III install using the browser asset manager; game data is kept in private browser storage (OPFS). This is an unofficial, in-progress client, not a Blizzard web release.

games.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Pripyat (ZoneVM)
games.desc: ZoneVM brings OpenXRay to the browser for Call of Pripyat and Call of Chernobyl; select your game folder and launch the original FPS/RPG.
games.controls: Original PC keyboard/mouse controls • Esc is rebound to Right Shift for in-game pause/menu • Click the game view to focus input.
games.goodToKnow: Requires your own Call of Pripyat or Call of Chernobyl game folder; the client keeps a copy in browser-private storage and writes saves/screenshots back to that folder. The project is very WIP and not thoroughly tested—expect bugs and crashes. Use fullscreen: Ctrl+W can close the tab, and Right Shift replaces Esc for in-game menus.

games.title: Azeroth Survivors (World of Warcraft Survivors)
games.desc: A free fan-made survivors roguelike set in vanilla World of Warcraft 1.12.1. Pick a race, class and zone, then steer through hordes of that zone's real creatures while your spells cast themselves and every level offers three upgrade cards.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to aim and steer • 1 / 2 / 3 to pick level-up cards • R to reroll • Space to jump • F for your class movement spell • C to lock the camera • Wheel to zoom • Enter to start • Esc to pause
games.goodToKnow: Needs WebGPU: Chrome or Edge 113+, Safari 26+, or Firefox with dom.webgpu.enabled. The first visit streams roughly 140 MB of world data, then the browser caches it. If the host says "Too many people are playing", wait a few minutes and reload. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Blizzard.

games.title: Diablo Survivors (3D Multiplayer)
games.desc: Pick a hero at the camp fire, step through the portal and survive the horde in this 3D third-person Diablo survivors-like. Chests deal reward cards, Horadric runs drop runes and gear, and friends can drop into the same world.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to aim and look • Left Click to attack • Skill keys to cast • E to interact • P for Heroes Online • Esc for the menu
games.goodToKnow: Opens straight in the browser with no sign-in and no download; multiplayer sessions are hosted on Spawn. Chests, runes and difficulty unlocks persist between runs. Unofficial fan project set in Diablo's world.

games.title: D2 Survivors (Diablo II Survivors)
games.desc: Diablo II's world turned into a survivors-like: all seven heroes and their skill trees, D2's own loot from the first drop to a gold-named unique, five acts, then Nightmare and Hell. Your skills cast themselves as you walk.
games.controls: WASD to walk • Mouse to aim • Skills cast automatically • 1 / 2 / 3 to choose level-up cards • I for inventory • Esc for menu
games.goodToKnow: You must own Diablo II (1.14 with Lord of Destruction) or Diablo II: Resurrected. The browser client reads the .MPQ files from your install once and keeps them in browser storage — nothing is uploaded. Free desktop builds are also offered.

games.title: PokéBonk (3D Pokémon Survivors)
games.desc: A free 3D Pokémon survivor game in the style of Megabonk. Pick Bulbasaur, Charmander or Squirtle, dodge wild hordes, evolve mid-run and fire your Ultimate across classic zones, guardians and an endless Survival mode.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to orbit the camera • Space to jump (hold to glide) • Shift to slide • E to interact • R for Ultimate • Right Click to lock on • Q for auto/manual aim • P or Esc to pause
games.goodToKnow: Play only at the official pokebonk.com — the look-alike .app, .io, .online and .site domains are not the author's. Play as a guest, or make an account to keep progress, clans and leaderboard entries. Made with AI-assisted assets, as the site's legal page states.

games.title: PokéSurvivor (966 Pokémon)
games.desc: A 2D bullet-heaven Pokémon fan game with 966 Pokémon across all nine regions. Pick a partner, clear Mystery Dungeon-style runs, hunt shinies and rift legendaries, and play co-op with up to four friends.
games.controls: WASD or arrow keys to move • Tap or click menus • Attacks fire automatically • Pick an upgrade on every level • Esc for menu
games.goodToKnow: Play as a guest or link an account or Google login to keep progress across devices; guest progress stays in that browser. Free, with no ads and no purchases. The game is played in landscape, including on phones.

games.title: Pokémon Survivors (Bullet Heaven)
games.desc: A full Vampire Survivors-style Pokémon roguelite: 27 starters, mid-run evolutions, 207 moves, 91 abilities, legendary boss fights, rifts and Mega Evolution. Survive 15 minutes, beat Mewtwo, then face endless Arceus.
games.controls: WASD to walk, or tap and drag on mobile • Attacks are automatic • 1 / 2 / 3 to choose upgrades • E to talk • Esc to go back
games.goodToKnow: No download and no sign-up; progress, eggs and caught legendaries save in your browser. A Halloween 2026 Darkrai event runs from 24 October to 2 November. Unofficial fan game.

games.title: Bacon Survivor (Pork Survivors-like)
games.desc: The closest thing we could verify to a "Pork Survivors" game: SnoutUp's bacon-flavoured bullet-heaven, where a brave pig fights endless waves with guns, abilities and unlockable weapons in a monster-infested kitchen.
games.controls: WASD or arrow keys to move • Weapons fire on their own • Gamepad supported • On-screen joystick on phones
games.goodToKnow: Official SnoutUp release hosted on Poki, also on Android and iOS. Free and no account needed. We could not find any game literally titled "Pork Survivors" — this is the verified pig-themed survivor game.

games.title: Doom (Wasm Doom)
games.desc: Cloudflare's Chocolate Doom compiled to WebAssembly: the free shareware episode Knee-Deep in the Dead, played solo or in online deathmatch over WebSockets. The original look and feel, not a remaster.
games.controls: Arrow keys to move and turn • Ctrl to fire • Space to open doors and use switches • Shift to run • Alt + Left/Right to strafe • 1–7 for weapons • Tab for map • Esc for menu
games.goodToKnow: Only the free shareware episode is included; Doom II and the paid episodes are not. Click the canvas first so the keyboard goes to the game. Choose Start Multiplayer to get a link you can share for deathmatch.

games.title: Crash Bash Online
games.desc: An unofficial browser port of the PS1 party classic Crash Bash, with all 28 battle arenas, the full Adventure mode and 2–4 player online rooms. Empty seats are filled by CPU players.
games.controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move • Space to jump • X to attack • Z to pick up or throw • C to taunt • Gamepad and on-screen touch pad supported
games.goodToKnow: Battle and Tournament need no account; Adventure mode saves to a free account. Rooms are hosted in Europe first, so distant players may see lag. Click the speaker icon once to enable sound.

games.title: Tomb Raider (OpenLara)
games.desc: OpenLara, XProger's open-source re-implementation of the original Tomb Raider engine, running in WebGL. The web build streams classic level data, so you can start raiding without importing your own files.
games.controls: Arrow keys to move and turn • D to jump • Ctrl to grab, use and shoot • Space to draw weapons • Shift to walk • A to roll • C to look • Tab for inventory
games.goodToKnow: The author's server is slow on first load — wait, or reload if it stalls. The web build offers the Caves and City of Vilcabamba demo levels, and can load your own .PHD, .PSX or .TR level files.

games.title: OpenTTD Online (Transport Tycoon)
games.desc: A WebAssembly build of OpenTTD 15.3, the open-source Transport Tycoon Deluxe. Build rail, road, sea and air networks across random maps and scenarios, with the full company, finance and vehicle windows.
games.controls: Mouse to build and drag the map • Right-drag to scroll • Wheel to zoom • Use the toolbar to pause • Full manual at the OpenTTD wiki
games.goodToKnow: First start downloads about 11 MB of free OpenGFX graphics — keep the tab open while it counts up. If text shows as empty boxes, set Game Options → Language to English. Saves live in browser storage, so export anything important.

games.title: Chrono Divide (Red Alert 2)
games.desc: A fan-made rewrite of the Red Alert 2 engine in JavaScript and WebGL, with online multiplayer, quick match, skirmish against bots, replays and mod support. The single-player campaigns are not in yet.
games.controls: Left and right click to select and command (classic or modern scheme) • Drag to box-select • Pan with the arrow keys, WASD or screen edge • RA2 hotkeys
games.goodToKnow: Needs Red Alert 2 data files (ra2.mix, language.mix and multi.mix from v1.006) imported once; the client keeps them in browser storage and uploads nothing. 64-bit Chrome, Edge or Safari recommended.
alsoKnownAs: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 2 in the browser

games.title: Road Rash (Three.js Port)
games.desc: A Three.js remake of the 1996 Windows Road Rash with the original courses, bike stats, rider sprites, cutscenes and grunge soundtrack. Race, punch and kick your way through five California courses.
games.controls: Arrow keys or WASD to steer, accelerate and brake • Z / X (or Space / Ctrl) to punch left and right • C / K to kick • N for nitro • V to change view • Esc to pause
games.goodToKnow: Click the page once to enable sound. Touch controls and tilt steering work on phones, and Mano-a-Mano has relayed online rooms. Unofficial fan project — EA is not involved.

games.title: WipEout (wipeout-rewrite)
games.desc: A near-complete C rewrite of the 1995 PlayStation anti-gravity racer, running in WebAssembly. Choose the full build with music and intro, or the 11 MB minimal build for a quick race.
games.controls: Arrow keys to steer • X to thrust • Z to fire • C and V for air brakes • A to change view
games.goodToKnow: Pick FULL (about 144 MB) or MINIMAL (about 11 MB) on the start screen — the full version streams before play. Click the canvas so the keys reach the game. Unofficial fan rewrite, not endorsed by Sony.

games.title: LEGO Island (isle.pizza)
games.desc: The full 1997 LEGO Island running in a tab from the community decompilation. Explore the island, build vehicles, deliver pizzas as Pepper Roni and stop the Brickster across all three acts.
games.controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move • Mouse to interact • Gamepad and touch supported • Configure controls on the site's Configure page
games.goodToKnow: Needs a modern browser with WebAssembly threads: Chrome or Edge 95+, Firefox 92+, Safari 15.4+. Game data streams as you play, and an optional offline install of about 550 MB is offered.

games.title: Lugaru (Lugaru-Web)
games.desc: Wolfire's open-source 3D rabbit brawler compiled to WebAssembly with the open game data included. Play Turner through the campaign with close combat, counters, swords and stealth.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to look • Left Click to attack • Space to jump • Shift to sneak or run • Number keys to draw weapons • Gamepad supported
games.goodToKnow: Create a player name with a keyboard before starting; progress saves in the browser. This runs the real Lugaru 1.3 engine from the OSS release, not a remake.

games.title: Alley Cat (alleycat.exe)
games.desc: The 1984 IBM PC classic Alley Cat, recompiled from its DOS executable into a browser build. Leap through windows as a stray cat chasing mice, fish bowls, milk and the lady cat.
games.controls: Cursor keys to move and jump • Alt (Option on Mac) for the room's special action • K / H / T / A pick difficulty • Ctrl+S toggles sound • Ctrl+R returns to the title screen
games.goodToKnow: Press a key or click first so the browser allows sound. The author states that about 99% of the recompiler's code was AI-generated and only lightly reviewed — play at your own comfort level.

games.title: SimCity Classic (micropolisJS)
games.desc: micropolisJS is a hand-written JavaScript port of Micropolis, the GPL release of the original 1989 SimCity. Zone land, power it, wire roads and balance the budget through fires, floods and monster attacks.
games.controls: Mouse to pick tools and place tiles • Settings for game speed • Budget, Evaluation and Disasters panels on the left • Generate another to reroll the map
games.goodToKnow: Free and legal under the GPL, though the SimCity trademark is not licensed. There is one save slot in browser storage. Zones need power before they will grow.

games.title: Cricket 07 (Browser Recompilation)
games.desc: EA Sports Cricket 07 statically recompiled to WebAssembly and playable in a desktop tab. Full matches against the CPU, local multiplayer with controllers and online 1v1 room-code games.
games.controls: Arrow keys to move, aim a shot and place the ball • S to select, play a normal shot or bowl a stock delivery • W to go back • Hold Shift for lofted shots • D to advance or take a run • A to cancel • Esc to pause • Alt+Enter for fullscreen
games.goodToKnow: The first visit downloads about 740 MB (Lite is about 440 MB); the full game needs roughly 1.2 GB of free space and WebGPU, so use Chrome or Edge on a desktop. Saves live in browser storage and have no export yet.

games.title: Counter-Strike Surf (Surfd.net)
games.desc: Pure Counter-Strike surfing physics replicated flawlessly in the browser. Glide along steep ramps at terminal velocity, master air strafing, and race against the clock.
games.controls: WASD & Strafe (A & D) • Smooth Mouse Sweeps • Space to jump • R to restart ramp • Tab for timer leaderboard
games.goodToKnow: Never hold W while surfing! Hold A when on the right side of a ramp, and D when on the left side. Steer gently with mouse.

games.title: Halo: Combat Evolved (Combat Lab)
games.desc: Mitchell Hynes's browser port of Master Chief's debut, now called Combat Lab: play the campaign on the Pillar of Autumn and beyond, or jump into online rooms with friends.
games.controls: WASD move • Mouse aim • LMB fire • RMB/G grenade • Space jump • E/R action & reload • Esc pause • Controller supported
games.goodToKnow: Downloads a WebAssembly runtime on first load. Click the game (or "Focus game") to capture the mouse. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Microsoft or Halo Studios.

games.title: Skate 3 (Web Fan Project)
games.desc: Shred the plaza in Port Carverton! Recreates the fluid analog flick-it board physics and ragdoll bail mechanics of the beloved EA Skate franchise.
games.controls: Gamepad Analog Sticks Recommended • Keyboard: Arrow Keys / WASD for board manipulation & Ollies
games.goodToKnow: Plug in an Xbox or PlayStation controller for the authentic dual-stick flick-it trick experience.

games.title: Pro Evolution Soccer 6 (PES 6 Web)
games.desc: Widely celebrated as the greatest soccer simulation ever made. Master crisp one-touch passing, tactical build-up play, and unleash Adriano’s legendary 99-shot-power rockets.
games.controls: Arrow Keys for D-Pad • Z/X/C/V or A/S/D/W for Pass, Through Ball, Shoot, Sprint • Gamepad fully mapped
games.goodToKnow: Runs via in-browser PPSSPP WebAssembly. Full screen mode is highly recommended for best stadium immersion.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (reVC WASM)
games.desc: Cruise down Ocean Drive in 1986 as Tommy Vercetti. Palm trees, synthwave radio, Hawaiian shirts, and open-world chaos powered by the pristine reverse-engineered reVC engine.
games.controls: WASD to move/steer • Mouse to aim • Left Click to fire/punch • Space for handbrake/jump • F/Enter to enter vehicles
games.goodToKnow: Save files persist in browser local storage. Click canvas to capture mouse look.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto III (re3 WASM)
games.desc: The revolutionary title that introduced 3D open-world gaming. Guide Claude through the crime-ridden districts of Liberty City, steal cars, evade the LCPD, and complete underworld contracts.
games.controls: WASD to run/steer • Left Click to fire • Space to sprint/handbrake • F or Enter to jack vehicles • C to change camera
games.goodToKnow: Hosted on WASM Arcade with optimized WebGL rendering and instant browser memory allocation.

games.title: The Simpsons: Hit & Run (SHAR WASM)
games.desc: The holy grail of cartoon sandbox games. Drive around Springfield as Homer, Bart, Lisa, and Apu, smashing wasp cameras, kicking pedestrians, and uncovering the alien conspiracy.
games.controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to drive/run • Space to jump/handbrake • Left Click / E to kick • Enter to get in cars
games.goodToKnow: Pre-configured with ?skipmovie parameter for instant direct-to-menu loading. Fast and buttery smooth.

games.title: Minecraft Java 1.8.8 (Eaglercraft WASM)
games.desc: Full Minecraft Java Edition 1.8.8 running natively in your browser! Craft tools, mine diamonds, build towering castles, create survival worlds with local saves, or join online multiplayer servers.
games.controls: WASD to walk • Space to jump • Left Click to mine/attack • Right Click to place block/use • E for inventory • Q to drop
games.goodToKnow: Singleplayer worlds save automatically to your browser’s IndexedDB! Can also load custom texture packs and connect to Eaglercraft servers.

games.title: Quake (QuakeWorld Online)
games.desc: The birth of full 3D first-person shooters and multiplayer esports. Rocket jump across dark slipgates, grab the Quad Damage, and frag opponents in DM6 and DM4.
games.controls: WASD to move • Mouse to look & fire • Space to jump (and rocket jump) • 1-8 to switch weapons • Tab for scoreboard
games.goodToKnow: Live server browser included in the menu! You can join public deathmatch matches immediately.

games.title: Quake II (JSQuake II)
games.desc: Infiltrate the Strogg home world in id Software’s industrial sci-fi sequel. Pick up the legendary Railgun, Super Shotgun, and BFG10K with smooth 120+ FPS browser rendering.
games.controls: WASD to strafe/move • Mouse aim & fire • Wheel or numbers to swap weapons • Space to jump • C to crouch
games.goodToKnow: Full multiplayer support with active dedicated servers and bot support.

games.title: Quake III Arena (ioquake3 Web)
games.desc: Welcome to the Arena Eternal. The pinnacle of pure competitive arena shooters. Jump pads, railgun flick shots, instagib mode, and iconic maps like The Longest Yard (q3dm17).
games.controls: WASD to strafe • Mouse to aim • Left Click to fire • Space to jump • Shift to walk • T for chat
games.goodToKnow: Instant-play multiplayer with active servers, low-ping WebSockets netcode, and AI bots.

games.title: Return to Castle Wolfenstein (iortcw Web)
games.desc: Fight as B.J. Blazkowicz against occult paranormal divisions and cyborg super-soldiers. Features legendary team-based objective multiplayer with Medic, Engineer, and Lieutenant classes.
games.controls: WASD to move • Left Click to shoot • Right Click to aim/alt-fire • Space to jump • C to crouch • X for prone
